reason: If the school's teacher keeps assigning it and checking it in class, and the end-of-term re-test shows the weak topics went up, I will pay the ₹249 a month. Marks matter more to me than a few hundred rupees, and I don't want my child to be the one in class who isn't doing it.
objection: The school is the one using it for homework, so the school should pay for it out of the fees I already pay, not charge me extra. And a better score on their own diagnostic is not the same as better exam marks and rank.
would_change_my_mind: If the teacher stopped assigning it after the pilot, or the re-test showed no real gain in the chapters that come in exams, I would not pay.
